name: University of Szeged
summary: Szeged university with 12 faculties and up to 25,000 students; English-taught medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, business, IT, psychology and music.

ib.text: IB Diploma can exempt you from the entrance exam: grade 5 in two HL sciences for medicine and dentistry, 4 for pharmacy, nursing, physio; Maths SL 4 or HL 3 for business. Predicted grades give conditional offers.

dates.label: First 2027 entrance-exam session, online (medicine); register by 19 January
Last 2027 entrance-exam session, online (medicine); register by 15 June

programmes.name: General Medicine
programmes.about: Twelve-semester medical degree in English (360 ECTS): two basic-science years, then regular clinical practice in teaching hospitals and a final internship year of clinical rotations.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma with grade 5 in two HL sciences (biology, chemistry, physics) exempts you from the entrance exam; otherwise a biology, chemistry and English exam decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Online exam (written test, then oral interviews). IB Diploma with 5 in two HL sciences is exempt; predicted grades give a conditional offer. About 250 places a year.

needs.note: Two of the three at HL; only for the exemption from the entrance exam

programmes.name: Dental Medicine
programmes.about: Ten-semester dental degree in English (300 ECTS) from the Faculty of Dentistry, ending in the DMD title.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma with grade 5 in two HL sciences (biology, chemistry, physics) exempts you from the entrance exam; otherwise a biology, chemistry and English exam decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Online exam of 20-30 minutes (two biology and two chemistry topics, plus English). IB Diploma with 5 in two HL sciences is exempt; predicted grades give a conditional offer.

needs.note: Two of the three at HL; only for the exemption from the entrance exam

programmes.name: Pharmacy
programmes.about: Ten-semester pharmacy degree in English (300 ECTS) from the Faculty of Pharmacy, ending in the title Doctor Pharmaciae.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma with grade 4 in two HL sciences or HL maths exempts you from the entrance exam; otherwise a biology, chemistry and English exam decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Exam in biology, chemistry (or physics) and English. IB Diploma with 4 in two HL of biology, chemistry, physics, maths is exempt; predicted grades give a conditional offer.

needs.note: Two of these at HL; only for the exemption from the entrance exam

programmes.name: Nurse
programmes.about: Eight-semester nursing degree in English (240 ECTS) from the Faculty of Health Sciences and Social Studies.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma with grade 4 in two natural sciences or maths at SL or above exempts you from the entrance exam; otherwise the exam tests English only.
programmes.selectionNote: Applying to Nurse only, the entrance exam covers just English. IB Diploma with 4 in two of biology, chemistry, physics, maths is exempt; a motivational interview may follow.

needs.note: Two of these; only for the exemption from the entrance exam

programmes.name: Physiotherapist
programmes.about: Eight-semester physiotherapy degree in English (240 ECTS) from the Faculty of Health Sciences and Social Studies.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma with grade 4 in two of biology, chemistry, physics, maths or sports science at SL or above exempts you from the entrance exam.
programmes.selectionNote: Entrance exam, with English tested. IB Diploma with 4 in two of biology, chemistry, physics, maths, sports science is exempt; a motivational interview may follow.

needs.note: Two of these; only for the exemption from the entrance exam

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: Six-semester psychology degree in English (180 ECTS) from the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, with an online written entrance test based on an introductory psychology textbook.
programmes.ib: No IB rule: B2 English proof (IB in English counts via a school statement), a motivation letter and an online written entrance test, which mainly decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Mainly the online written test, which draws on chapters of Atkinson & Hilgard's Introduction to Psychology; motivation letter (no AI help) and B2 English proof also required.

programmes.name: Business Administration and Management
programmes.about: Seven-semester business degree in English (210 ECTS) that ends in an internship semester; the EFMD-accredited programme trains managers across industries.
programmes.ib: IB Maths at SL 4 or HL 3 exempts you from the maths entrance exam; other parts of the exam, in the university's study system, and B2 English remain.
programmes.selectionNote: Written and oral entrance exam in the university's electronic system, with a maths part; IB Maths SL 4 or HL 3 skips the maths exam. Solid maths is advised.

needs.note: SL grade 4 or HL grade 3; only for the exemption from the maths exam

programmes.name: Tourism and Catering
programmes.about: Eight-semester tourism and hospitality degree in English (240 ECTS) on current industry trends, digital tourism tools, leadership, and regional marketing.
programmes.ib: IB Maths at SL 4 or HL 3 exempts you from the maths entrance exam; other parts of the exam and B2 English remain.
programmes.selectionNote: Written and oral entrance exam in the university's electronic system, with a maths part; IB Maths SL 4 or HL 3 skips the maths exam. Solid maths is advised.

needs.note: SL grade 4 or HL grade 3; only for the exemption from the maths exam

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Six-semester computer science degree in English (180 ECTS): building, developing, operating and servicing IT systems, alone and in teams.
programmes.ib: No IB rule: B2 English proof and an online interview as the entrance exam.
programmes.selectionNote: Entrance exam is an online interview; B2 English proof, a motivation letter and a medical certificate are also required.

programmes.name: Biochemical Engineer
programmes.about: Seven-semester degree in English (210 ECTS) training bioengineers to apply biology in industry and applied science, with an internship at a company or non-profit.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma is accepted as the compulsory English proof; no other IB rule is published.
programmes.selectionNote: Entry on a secondary diploma, English proof (the IB Diploma counts) and a general health certificate; no separate entrance exam is described.

programmes.name: Agricultural Engineering
programmes.about: Seven-semester agricultural engineering degree in English (210 ECTS) on crop and animal production, horticulture and farm management, taught at the Faculty of Agriculture.
programmes.ib: No IB rule: an online English written and oral entrance exam; science results from previous studies are considered.
programmes.selectionNote: Online entrance exam testing English (written plus oral, often at a consulate site); science results from earlier studies are considered.

programmes.name: English and American Studies
programmes.credential: BA (Philologist in English and American Studies)
programmes.about: Six-semester BA (180 ECTS) in the cultures, history, language and literatures of the UK and US, with English and American tracks and a required minor.
programmes.ib: No IB rule: B2+ English certificate (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 87), or a school statement if you studied at an international school, plus a motivation letter.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on documents: advanced English certificate (or an international-school statement), secondary certificate and a motivation letter written without AI help.

programmes.name: Performance - Cello
programmes.about: Six-semester BA (180 ECTS) in instrumental performance and classical singing at the Béla Bartók Faculty of Arts, with theory, chamber music and orchestral playing.
programmes.ib: An audition recording and B2 English proof (IELTS 5.5 or equivalent) are required; no IB subject is asked.
programmes.selectionNote: Admission follows a demo recording of the faculty's audition requirements, plus B2 English and your secondary certificate.

family.name: Music Performance (BA)
family.differs: Cello as the main instrument; same audition-recording entry and fee as the other instruments.

notes: Every English programme has one published euro price per semester, the same for all applicants; medicine is €7,900, dentistry €8,000 and pharmacy €5,420, with a first-semester deposit in medicine and dentistry.
One €300 fee covers up to three health programmes (medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, nursing, physio) and two exam tries; other programmes charge €79 each, and some add a €100-250 exam fee.
The portal shows the 2026/27 application period as ended and gives no 2027/28 deadlines yet; medicine's 2027 exam calendar is published, with nine online sessions from January to June.
